name: Sydney R. Marovitz Golf Course
location: Lincoln Park lakefront, Chicago, Cook County, Illinois
architects: Edward B. Dearie Jr. (1932, as Waveland Golf Course; club website sydneymarovitz.cpdgolf.com/the-course)

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, project IL_4_County_QL1_LiDAR_2016_B16, tile x44y465 (published 2024-11-18), clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py raster; fetched by the GitHub Actions fetch workflow 2026-10-31 (release data-marovitz)

laz.source: USGS 3DEP lidar point cloud IL_4_County_QL1_LiDAR_2016_B16 (IL_4County_Cook_2017, flown 17-18 April 2017, leaf-off), tiles LAS_17009250 and LAS_17009275, classes 3-5, clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py laz; NAD83(2011) / Illinois East US survey feet, NAVD88 feet; fetched by the GitHub Actions fetch workflow 2026-10-31 (release data-marovitz). The east-column tiles (LAS_17259250, LAS_17259275: the lakeshore strip east of x = 446,830 m) did not download (rockyweb 429/timeout, S3 404), so the 110 m-wide east edge of the course has no lidar trees
laz.label: 2017 USGS lidar (Cook County)

world.note: OSM course boundary way/24951326 bbox (464 x 1,114 m) + scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 768 m east-west (152 m each side), 1,536 m north-south (211 m each side)

scorecard_source: Club scorecard PDF (sydneymarovitz.cpdgolf.com, wp-content/uploads/sites/9687/2025/08/sydney-marovitz-10.20.pdf), read 2026-10-31; a copy is in the release data-marovitz (marovitz_scorecard_2025.pdf). Ratings are the card's men's 9-hole figures (women's on the card: Blue 38.4/138, White 37.1/133, Red 34.1/120). Conflicts (not used): GolfLink Blue 3,240 (35.1/117) and Red 3,156; Hole19 White 2,774 and Red 2,279; OSM hole 2 par 4 (card par 5). Built: Blue and White (developer's overnight call 2026-10-30: the back set, which is Blue, and the next set forward).
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (2017 Cook County lidar)
Scorecard: Sydney R. Marovitz Golf Course (Chicago Park District)
notes: Overnight build 2026-10-30/31 (developer asleep; calls made by the course chat and logged in validation_report.md and docs/courses/marovitz.md): Blue and White built, Blue default; card pars win over OSM (hole 2 par 5); all water red; Lake Michigan and the harbours are outside the boundary (out of bounds); wind 3-14 mph by analogy with the open-coast band (the course sits on the open Lake Michigan shore); new theme marovitz (urban lakefront parkland: elm, honey locust, cottonwood, spruce; Lake Michigan teal water).
